title: CEFR C1 — Mastery & Rhetoric
description: Academic connectors, abstract precision, classic Spanish proverbs (refranes), and high-register rhetoric.

units.title: Editorial & Academic Discourse
units.subtitle: Discurso académico · Formal connectors and structured writing

lessons.title: High-Register Connectors
lessons.objective: Elevate essays and formal speeches seamlessly.
lessons.grammarNote: Replace everyday 'pero' and 'entonces' with 'no obstante' and 'por consiguiente' in formal prose.

example.term: El reto es grande; no obstante, es factible.
example.translation: The challenge is large; nevertheless, it's feasible.

example.term: Por consiguiente, conviene modularizar el temario.
example.translation: Consequently, modularizing the syllabus is wise.

example.term: En aras de la sencillez, evitamos saturar la pantalla.
example.translation: For the sake of simplicity, we avoid cluttering the screen.

example.term: Cabe destacar la rapidez del paquete Android.
example.translation: It is worth highlighting the speed of the Android package.

example.term: Al margen del idioma, el método es consistente.
example.translation: Regardless of language, the method is consistent.

lessons.title: Framing Arguments
lessons.grammarNote: Use 'si bien' (although) to introduce balanced concessions in academic Spanish.

example.term: Si bien el inicio es sencillo, llega hasta C1.
example.translation: Although the start is simple, it reaches C1.

example.term: A raíz de las pruebas móviles, rediseñamos el panel.
example.translation: Following mobile tests, we redesigned the layout.

example.term: En virtud de su licencia abierta, cualquiera puede mejorarla.
example.translation: By virtue of its open license, anyone can improve it.

example.term: Sobra decir que la constancia marca la diferencia.
example.translation: Needless to say, consistency makes the difference.

example.term: En última instancia, decide el estudiante.
example.translation: Ultimately, the learner decides.

lessons.title: Formal Verbs of Analysis
lessons.objective: Articulate nuance with crisp scholarly verbs.
lessons.grammarNote: Verbs like 'abordar' (address/tackle) and 'vislumbrar' (glimpse/foresee) enrich formal writing.

example.term: Abordamos desde saludos hasta retórica.
example.translation: We tackle everything from greetings to rhetoric.

example.term: No debemos eludir los temas difíciles.
example.translation: We must not sidestep hard topics.

example.term: La guía sintetiza la gramática clave.
example.translation: The guidebook synthesizes key grammar.

example.term: Los datos respaldan el repaso espaciado.
example.translation: Data backs up spaced repetition.

example.term: Las tarjetas consolidan lo aprendido.
example.translation: Flashcards consolidate what was learned.

units.title: Precision & Abstract Critique
units.subtitle: Matices y rigor · Expressing subtle distinctions

lessons.title: Abstract Nouns
lessons.objective: Discuss nuance, premises, paradoxes, and coherence.
lessons.grammarNote: Mastering abstract nouns lets you read Spanish literature, essays, and opinion columns effortlessly.

example.term: Cada traducción cuida el matiz cultural.
example.translation: Every translation respects cultural nuance.

example.term: Partimos de una premisa clara: cero barreras.
example.translation: We start from a clear premise: zero barriers.

example.term: Es una paradoja que lo más simple requiera más diseño.
example.translation: It's a paradox that the simplest thing needs the most design.

example.term: La coherencia visual mejora la retención.
example.translation: Visual coherence improves retention.

example.term: Los ejemplos en contexto reducen la ambigüedad.
example.translation: In-context examples reduce ambiguity.

lessons.title: Exact Adjectives
lessons.objective: Describe clarity, rigor, and elegance accurately.
lessons.grammarNote: Notice expressive C1 adjectives like 'riguroso' (thorough), 'escueto' (concise), and 'versátil'.

example.term: Un plan de estudios riguroso y ameno.
example.translation: A rigorous yet enjoyable curriculum.

example.term: El formato JSON resulta sumamente versátil.
example.translation: The JSON format proves exceedingly versatile.

example.term: Un flujo intuitivo para pantallas táctiles.
example.translation: An intuitive flow for touchscreens.

example.term: Preferimos ejemplos fidedignos de uso real.
example.translation: We prefer authentic real-world examples.

example.term: Hay una diferencia sutil entre ser y estar.
example.translation: There is a subtle difference between ser and estar.

lessons.title: Expressing Degree & Clarity
lessons.grammarNote: Adverbs like 'sumamente' (exceedingly) and 'cabalmente' (fully) elevate formal fluency.

example.term: Es sumamente práctico para estudiar viajando.
example.translation: It is exceedingly practical for studying while traveling.

example.term: La dificultad aumenta paulatinamente.
example.translation: Difficulty rises steadily.

example.term: Rechazó rotundamente el muro de pago.
example.translation: They emphatically rejected the paywall.

example.term: Comprende cabalmente la estructura.
example.translation: Thoroughly understands the structure.

example.term: Las unidades se distinguen nítidamente.
example.translation: Units are clearly distinguished.

units.title: Classic Proverbs (Refranes)
units.subtitle: Refranes · Timeless wisdom across Spain & Latin America

lessons.title: Proverbs of Perseverance
lessons.objective: Learn classic sayings about steady progress.
lessons.grammarNote: Spanish refranes are rhythmic, punchy, and quoted constantly in daily conversation.

items.term: Poco a poco se anda lejos
items.transliteration: POH-koh ah POH-koh seh AHN-dah LEH-hohs
items.translation: Little by little, one goes far

example.term: No corras: poco a poco se anda lejos.
example.translation: Don't rush: little by little, one goes far.

items.translation: Where there's a will, there's a way

example.term: Con práctica diaria lo lograrás: querer es poder.
example.translation: With daily practice you'll do it: where there's a will, there's a way.

example.term: Nunca es tarde para aprender: más vale tarde que nunca.
example.translation: It's never late to learn: better late than never.

items.term: El que la sigue la consigue
items.transliteration: ehl keh lah SEE-geh lah kohn-SEE-geh

example.term: Sigue repasando: el que la sigue la consigue.
example.translation: Keep reviewing: persistence pays off.

example.term: Haz una lección diaria: la práctica hace al maestro.
example.translation: Do a daily lesson: practice makes perfect.

lessons.title: Proverbs of Wisdom
lessons.objective: Understand cultural refranes heard in films and books.
lessons.grammarNote: Notice how refranes condense entire moral lessons into one memorable sentence.

items.term: No hay mal que por bien no venga
items.transliteration: noh eye mahl keh pohr byehn noh BEHN-gah
items.translation: Every cloud has a silver lining

example.term: Aprendimos del fallo: no hay mal que por bien no venga.
example.translation: We learned from the bug: every cloud has a silver lining.

items.term: A buen entendedor, pocas palabras bastan
items.translation: A word to the wise is enough

example.term: Con un ejemplo basta: a buen entendedor, pocas palabras bastan.
example.translation: One example suffices: a word to the wise is enough.

example.term: Haz tu copia de seguridad: más vale prevenir que curar.
example.translation: Make your backup: better safe than sorry.

items.term: No es oro todo lo que reluce
items.transliteration: noh ehs OH-roh TOH-doh loh keh reh-LOO-seh
items.translation: All that glitters is not gold

example.term: Revisa el código: no es oro todo lo que reluce.
example.translation: Check the code: all that glitters is not gold.

items.translation: Don't bite off more than you can chew

example.term: Un paso cada día: quien mucho abarca, poco aprieta.
example.translation: One step a day: don't bite off more than you can chew.

lessons.title: Vivid Metaphorical Idioms
lessons.objective: Speak expressively with native figurative idioms.
lessons.grammarNote: Figurative idioms like 'dar en el clavo' bring speeches and conversations alive.

items.translation: To hit the nail on the head

example.term: Con ese diseño diste en el clavo.
example.translation: With that design you hit the nail on the head.

items.translation: To get straight to the point

example.term: Vamos al grano con las lecciones.
example.translation: Let's get straight to the point with the lessons.

items.translation: To be a piece of cake

example.term: Después de repasar, la prueba fue pan comido.
example.translation: After reviewing, the quiz was a piece of cake.

example.term: Si te quedas en blanco, escucha el audio.
example.translation: If you draw a blank, listen to the audio.

example.term: No traduzcas los modismos al pie de la letra.
example.translation: Don't translate idioms literally.

units.title: Rhetoric & Native Concession
units.subtitle: Retórica avanzada · Persuasion, irony, and polished conclusions

lessons.title: Advanced Concession
lessons.objective: Qualify claims subtly with 'por mucho que' and 'ni mucho menos'.
lessons.grammarNote: 'Por mucho que + subjunctive' means 'no matter how much...'.

example.term: Por mucho que memorices, hace falta contexto.
example.translation: No matter how much you memorize, context is needed.

items.translation: Not by a long shot / Far from it

example.term: No es imposible, ni mucho menos.
example.translation: It is not impossible—far from it.

example.term: Nadie pone en tela de juicio su utilidad.
example.translation: No one calls its usefulness into question.

example.term: Lejos de ser pesada, ocupa menos de un mega.
example.translation: Far from being heavy, it takes under a megabyte.

items.translation: After all / At the end of the day

example.term: A fin de cuentas, aprender debe ser divertido.
example.translation: At the end of the day, learning should be fun.

lessons.title: Persuasive Framing
lessons.grammarNote: Pair 'en primer lugar' with 'en definitiva' to frame clear multi-part arguments.

example.term: En definitiva, un estándar abierto gana siempre.
example.translation: Ultimately, an open standard always wins.

example.term: Dicho de otro modo, tu progreso siempre te pertenece.
example.translation: Put another way, your progress always belongs to you.

items.translation: Without a shadow of a doubt

example.term: Sin lugar a dudas, la comunidad es la clave.
example.translation: Without a shadow of a doubt, community is the key.

example.term: Sacaron adelante el proyecto contra viento y marea.
example.translation: They pulled off the project against all odds.

example.term: Cada voluntario pone su granito de arena.
example.translation: Every volunteer does their bit.

lessons.title: Mastery Capstone
lessons.objective: Celebrate fluency and discuss lifelong learning.
lessons.grammarNote: You've reached C1! Continue reviewing spaced-repetition cards to lock every level into long-term memory.

example.term: Alcanzaste un dominio sólido del español.
example.translation: You reached a solid command of Spanish.

example.term: Se expresa de manera clara y elocuente.
example.translation: Expresses themselves clearly and eloquently.

example.term: La fluidez nace del uso constante.
example.translation: Fluency is born from steady use.

example.term: Descubrir otra cultura es muy enriquecedor.
example.translation: Discovering another culture is deeply enriching.

example.term: Cada nueva lengua amplía tus horizontes.
example.translation: Each new language broadens your horizons.
